title: Freelance Quarterly Estimated Tax Calculator
description: Port of ApexLogics Apex #116 (AL-123) Freelance Quarterly Estimated Tax Calculator into the AINumbers chaingraph shape. From gross freelance income, business expenses, other income, a filing status (single/mfj), an elective state bucket (none/low/mid/high = 0/3/5/9.3%, an illustrative assumption rather than a jurisdiction lookup), prior-year federal tax and year-to-date payments, the node computes net SE income, SE tax (12.4% Social Security capped at the 2026 wage base $184,500 plus 2.9% Medicare on 92.35% of net earnings), AGI after the employer-equivalent half of SE tax, federal income tax on the 2026 brackets after the 2026 standard deduction ($16,100 single / $32,200 MFJ), equal quarterly installments of the annual total with the 2026 due dates, and the safe harbor (lesser of 100% prior-year or 90% current-year federal tax). One constant was corrected to the official source at porting: Q2 2026 ships as June 15, 2026 per IRS Form 1040-ES, where Apex listed June 16 (payload DIFFERS.md D1). Three Apex omissions ride flagged rather than silently patched: the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax, the 110% high-earner safe-harbor prong and the $1,000 de minimis exemption (DIFFERS.md D2-D4, report items R2-R3). Port provenance: Apex page https://apexlogics.org/tools/116-freelance-quarterly-estimated-tax/ fetched 2026-10-06 (30,666 bytes), tasking APEXPORT-116 (GRADES PASS-PENDING-XV 2026-10-07, Builder-verifies-at-land 19/19 vectors), landed by APEX-PORT-116-LAND-1 on 2026-10-20.

gross_income.description: Annual gross freelance / self-employment income in USD (Apex input grossIncome, default 120000, min 1000, max 2000000).

business_expenses.description: Business expenses in USD (Apex input expenses, default 15000, min 0, max 500000). Software, home office, equipment, professional fees, etc.

other_income.description: Other income in USD — W-2 wages, interest, dividends (Apex input otherIncome, default 0, min 0).

filing_status.description: Filing status (Apex select filingStatus). 'single' = Single / Married Filing Separately; 'mfj' = Married Filing Jointly.

state.description: State tax bucket (Apex select state). Illustrative elective rates: none=0, low=0.03, mid=0.05, high=0.093. An assumption, not a jurisdiction lookup.

prior_year_tax.description: Prior-year federal tax in USD (Form 1040 line 24; Apex priorYearTax, default 0). Drives the safe harbor; 0 selects the 90%-of-current fallback.

ytd_paid.description: Year-to-date estimated payments already made in USD (Apex input ytdPaid, default 0, min 0).

Unknown state keys price at rate 0 and non-mfj statuses price as single — the Apex page fallback, restated by the property-test floor.
